record_type_quote: Author Data Reproduction Attempt to Evaluate 5 Claims from Petersen_Cognition_2017_yJwG

targets.authors: Petersen, A., Petersen, A. H., Bundesen, C., Vangkilde, S., & Habekost, T.
targets.title: The effect of phasic auditory alerting on visual perception.
targets.evidence_quote: All claims relied on the same type of analysis: a paired t-test. Claims mjqwop and g12xod were evaluated using Study 1 data, claims g9l3pl and m4y9z9 were evaluated using Study 2 data and claim b574lj was evaluated using Study 3 data.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: Claims mjqwop, g9l3pl, and b574lj required two analysis attempts. For these claims, the analysis attempt 1 rendered negative focal statistics where a positive focal statistics were reported by the original authors. In the second analysis attempt, the presentation of variables in the paired samples t-test was reversed which allowed for exact reproduction of the original focal values.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: All claims relied on the same type of analysis: a paired t-test.
targets.outcome_reasoning: All five claim tables recover original statistics to rounding precision; variable ordering corrections do not invalidate computational reproducibility. Only original analyses were rerun; no alternative specifications are reported.
